header.title: Other- Undescribed Sample Schema
header.description: Other- Undescribed Schema for the AnalysisAPI

sample_name.title: sample name
sample_name.description: ID that is present on the shipped sample. Human readable.

analysis_type.title: analysis type
analysis_type.description: The analyses planned for this sample. The analysis types will later be mapped to an allocated resource. This field is constrained to contain only a set of limited terms. Include all the data types. This field can have multiple values separated by a ";".

sample_type.title: sample type
sample_type.description: Requires a standardized ontology term to describe what your sample is. Please search for your sample type via Ontology Lookup Sevice at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/

growth_facil.title: growth facility
growth_facil.description: Type of facility where the sample was collected or grown

shipped_sample_size.title: shipped sample size
shipped_sample_size.description: Total amount of sample sent to EMSL, include units

collection_date.title: collection date
collection_date.description: The date of sampling, either as an instance (single point) or interval. For commercially purchased samples, this will be the purchase date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Also valid, if entire collection date is unknown is just year (YYYY) or just year and month (YYYY-MM)

storage_condt.title: storage condition
storage_condt.description: The storage condition of the sample. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_storage_condt` attribute to provide additional detail.

samp_store_temp.title: sample storage temperature
samp_store_temp.description: The temperature at which your samples should be stored upon arrival. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_samp_store_temp` attribute to provide additional detail.

technical_reps.title: technical replicates
technical_reps.description: If sending technical replicates of the same sample, indicate the replicate number here.

replicate_number.title: replicate number
replicate_number.description: If samples are biological replicates, indicate the replicate number here.

source_mat_ID.title: source material identifier
source_mat_ID.description: A unique identifier assigned to an original material sample collected or to any derived sub-samples. The source material should be listed as a sample to inform details about parent material relationship.

sample_link.title: sample link
sample_link.description: A unique identifier to assign parent-child, subsample, or sibling samples. This is relevant when a sample or other material was used to generate the new sample. This field allows multiple entries separated by ; (Examples: Soil collected from the field will link with the soil used in an incubation. The soil a plant was grown in links to the plant sample. An original culture sample was transferred to a new vial and generated a new sample)

env_broad_scale.title: broad-scale environmental context
env_broad_scale.description: Report which major environmental system your sample or specimen came from. The systems identified should have a coarse spatial grain, to provide the general environmental context of where the sampling was done (e.g. were you in the desert or a rainforest?). We recommend using subclasses of ENVO's biome class: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00000428.

env_local_scale.title: local environmental context
env_local_scale.description: Report the entity which are in the sample or specimen's local vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample or specimen. We recommend using EnvO terms which are of smaller spatial grain than your entry for env_broad_scale. Terms, such as anatomical sites, from other OBO Library ontologies which interoperate with EnvO (e.g. UBERON) are accepted in this field. EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS.

env_medium.title: environmental medium
env_medium.description: Report the environmental material immediately surrounding the sample or specimen at the time of sampling. We recommend using subclasses of 'environmental material' (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00010483). EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS . Terms from other OBO ontologies are permissible as long as they reference mass/volume nouns (e.g. air, water, blood) and not discrete, countable entities (e.g. a tree, a leaf, a table top).

geo_loc_name.title: geographic location name
geo_loc_name.description: The geographical origin of the sample as defined by the country or sea name followed by specific region name. Provide the location of where the sample originated.

lat_lon.title: latitude longitude
lat_lon.description: The geographical origin of the sample as defined by latitude and longitude. The values should be reported in decimal degrees and in WGS84 system.

elev.title: elevation
elev.description: Elevation of the sampling site is its height above a fixed reference point, most commonly the mean sea level. Elevation is mainly used when referring to points on the earth's surface. (Unit: m).

sample_processing.title: sample processing
sample_processing.description: A brief description of any processing applied to the sample during or after retrieving the sample from environment, or a link to the relevant protocol(s) performed.

sample_collection_method.title: sample collection method
sample_collection_method.description: The method employed for collecting the sample. This can be a citation or description

depth.title: depth
depth.description: The vertical distance below local surface. For sediment or soil samples depth is measured from sediment or soil surface, respectively. Depth can be reported as an interval for subsurface samples. (Units: m)

cur_vegetation.title: current vegetation
cur_vegetation.description: Vegetation classification from one or more standard classification systems, or agricultural crop

cur_vegetation_meth.title: current vegetation method
cur_vegetation_meth.description: Reference or method used in vegetation classification

sample_collection_dev.title: sample collection devive
sample_collection_dev.description: The device used to collect an environmental sample. Include dimensions of device if applicable

start_date_inc.title: incubation start dte
start_date_inc.description: Date the incubation was started. Only relevant for incubation samples.

collection_time.title: collection time
collection_time.description: The time of sampling, either as an instance (single point) or interval. Time should be formatted as HH:MM:SS in 24-hour time format

bulk_elect_conductivity.title: bulk electrical conductivity
bulk_elect_conductivity.description: Electrical conductivity is a measure of the bulk soil ability to carry electric current, which is mostly dictated by the chemistry of and amount of soil water. (Unit: mS/cm)

temp.title: temperate
temp.description: Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling (Units: C)

sieving.title: sieving
sieving.description: Collection design of pooled samples and/or sieve size and amount of sample sieved

filter_method.title: filter method
filter_method.description: Type of filter used or how the sample was filteres

host_common_name.title: host common name
host_common_name.description: Common name of the host, e.g. Human

isol_growth_condt.title: isolation and growth conditions
isol_growth_condt.description: Publication reference in the form of pubmed ID (pmid), digital object identifier (doi) or url for isolation and growth condition specifications of the organism/material

growth_medium.title: growth medium
growth_medium.description: Method of growth and medium/materials used. Indicate broth, gel, 3-D structure, bioreactor, etc followed by the formula, recipe, or components used to create the growth medium.

watering_regm.title: watering regimen
watering_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

air_temp_regm.title: air temperature regimen
air_temp_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to varying temperatures; should include the temperature, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include different temperature regimens

chem_administration.title: chemical administration
chem_administration.description: List of chemical compounds administered to the host or site where sampling occurred, and when (e.g. Antibiotics, n fertilizer, air filter); can include multiple compounds. For chemical entities of biological interest ontology (chebi) (v 163), http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/chebi

isotope_exposure.title: isotope exposure
isotope_exposure.description: List isotope exposure or addition applied to your sample.

gaseous_environment.title: gaseous environment
gaseous_environment.description: Use of conditions with differing gaseous environments; should include the name of gaseous compound, amount administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple gaseous environment regimens

humidity_regm.title: humidity regimen
humidity_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to varying degree of humidity; information about treatment involving use of growth hormones; should include amount of humidity administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

light_regm.title: light regimen
light_regm.description: Information about treatment(s) involving exposure to light, including both light intensity and quality.

biotic_regm.title: biotic regimen
biotic_regm.description: Information about treatment(s) involving use of biotic factors, such as bacteria, viruses or fungi.

other_treatment.title: other treatment
other_treatment.description: If a treatment is applied to your samples and the provided "treatment" terms do not satisfy, please add it here. Multiple treatments can be entered here, separated by ;

extraction_method.title: extraction method
extraction_method.description: If you, the user, performed an extraction, preparation, or processing before sending the sample to EMSL, what was it? This is only applicable when sending an "analytical sample". See README for more details on types of samples.

method_development.title: method development
method_development.description: If your samples are TEST sample ONLY, please provide information on what you're hoping this test will resolve.

alt.title: altitude
alt.description: Altitude is a term used to identify heights of objects such as airplanes, space shuttles, rockets, atmospheric balloons and heights of places such as atmospheric layers and clouds. It is used to measure the height of an object which is above the earthbs surface. In this context, the altitude measurement is the vertical distance between the earth's surface above sea level and the sampled position in the air

synth_instrument.title: synthesizing instrument
synth_instrument.description: The instrumentation used to synthesize the material sample.

synth_reagents.title: synthesis reagents
synth_reagents.description: The reagents used in the material synthesis

synth_process.title: synthesis process
synth_process.description: Provide the citation or describe the method of synthesis.

other.title: other
other.description: Other details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in the available columns.

slope_aspect.title: slope aspect
slope_aspect.description: The direction a slope faces. While looking down a slope use a compass to record the direction you are facing (degrees); e.g., 315 degrees. This measure provides an indication of sun and wind exposure that will influence soil temperature and evapotranspiration. (Unit: degrees)

slope_gradient.title: slope gradient
slope_gradient.description: Commonly called 'slope'. The angle between ground surface and a horizontal line (in percent). This is the direction that overland water would flow. This measure is usually taken with a hand level meter or clinometer. (Unit: percent)

sample_collected.title: sample collected
sample_collected.description: This referes to the TOTAL amount of sample collected from the experiment. NOT the amount sent to EMSL or collected for a specific analysis. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

experimental_factor.title: experimental factor
experimental_factor.description: Experimental factors are essentially the variable aspects of an experiment design which can be used to describe an experiment, or set of experiments, in an increasingly detailed manner. This field accepts ontology terms from Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) and/or Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI). For a browser of EFO (v 2.95) terms, please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/EFO; for a browser of OBI (v 2018-02-12) terms please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/OBI

experimental_factor_other.title: experimental factor other
experimental_factor_other.description: Other details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in the available columns.

samp_biotic_relationship.title: sample biotic relationship
samp_biotic_relationship.description: Description of relationship(s) between the subject organism and other organism(s) it is associated with. E.g., parasite on species X; mutualist with species Y. The target organism is the subject of the relationship, and the other organism(s) is the object

encoded_traits.title: encoded traits
encoded_traits.description: Should include key traits like antibiotic resistance or xenobiotic degradation phenotypes for plasmids, converting genes for phage

host_spec_range.title: host specificity or range
host_spec_range.description: The NCBI taxonomy identifier of the specific host if it is known

pathogenicity.title: pathogenicity
pathogenicity.description: To what is the entity pathogenic

propagation.title: propagation
propagation.description: This field is specific to different taxa. For phages: lytic/lysogenic, for plasmids: incompatibility group, for eukaryotes: sexual/asexual (Note: there is the strong opinion to name phage propagation obligately lytic or temperate, therefore we also give this choice

ref_biomaterial.title: reference for biomaterial
ref_biomaterial.description: Primary publication if isolated before genome publication; otherwise, primary genome report.

subspecf_gen_lin.title: subspecific genetic lineage
subspecf_gen_lin.description: Information about the genetic distinctness of the sequenced organism below the subspecies level, e.g., serovar, serotype, biotype, ecotype, or any relevant genetic typing schemes like Group I plasmid. Subspecies should not be recorded in this term, but in the NCBI taxonomy. Supply both the lineage name and the lineage rank separated by a colon, e.g., biovar:abc123.

trophic_level.title: trophic level
trophic_level.description: Trophic levels are the feeding position in a food chain. Microbes can be a range of producers (e.g. chemolithotroph)

ances_data.title: ancestral data
ances_data.description: Information about either pedigree or other ancestral information description

antibiotic_regm.title: antibiotic regimen
antibiotic_regm.description: Information about treatment involving antibiotic administration; should include the name of antibiotic, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple antibiotic regimens

chem_mutagen.title: chemical mutagen
chem_mutagen.description: Treatment involving use of mutagens; should include the name of mutagen, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple mutagen regimens

fertilizer_regm.title: fertilizer regimen
fertilizer_regm.description: Information about treatment involving the use of fertilizers; should include the name of fertilizer, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple fertilizer regimens

fungicide_regm.title: fungicide regimen
fungicide_regm.description: Information about treatment involving use of fungicides; should include the name of fungicide, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple fungicide regimens

genetic_mod.title: genetic modigication
genetic_mod.description: Genetic modifications of the genome of an organism, which may occur naturally by spontaneous mutation, or be introduced by some experimental means, e.g. specification of a transgene or the gene knocked-out or details of transient transfection

gravity.title: gravity
gravity.description: Information about treatment involving use of gravity factor to study various types of responses in presence, absence or modified levels of gravity; treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple treatments

growth_habit.title: growth habitat
growth_habit.description: Characteristic shape, appearance or growth form of a plant species

growth_hormone_regm.title: growth hormone regimen
growth_hormone_regm.description: Information about treatment involving use of growth hormones; should include the name of growth hormone, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple growth hormone regimens

herbicide_regm.title: herbicide regimen
herbicide_regm.description: Information about treatment involving use of herbicides; information about treatment involving use of growth hormones; should include the name of herbicide, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

host_age.title: host age
host_age.description: Age of host at the time of sampling; relevant scale depends on species and study, e.g. Could be seconds for amoebae or centuries for trees

host_disease_stat.title: host disease status
host_disease_stat.description: List of diseases with which the host has been diagnosed; can include multiple diagnoses. The value of the field depends on host; for humans the terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at https://www.disease-ontology.org, non-human host diseases are free text

host_infra_spec_name.title: host infra-specific name
host_infra_spec_name.description: Taxonomic information about the host below subspecies level

host_infra_spec_rank.title: host infra-specific rank
host_infra_spec_rank.description: Taxonomic rank information about the host below subspecies level, such as variety, form, rank etc.

host_life_stage.title: host life stage
host_life_stage.description: Description of life stage of host

host_phenotype.title: host phenotype
host_phenotype.description: Phenotype of human or other host. For phenotypic quality ontology (pato) (v 2018-03-27) terms, please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/pato. For Human Phenotype Ontology (HP) (v 2018-06-13) please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/HP

host_symbiont.title: host symbiont
host_symbiont.description: The taxonomic name of the organism(s) found living in mutualistic, commensalistic, or parasitic symbiosis with the specific host.

host_tot_mass.title: host total mass
host_tot_mass.description: Total mass of the host at collection, the unit depends on host

mechanical_damage.title: mechanical damage
mechanical_damage.description: Information about any mechanical damage exerted on the plant; can include multiple damages and sites

mineral_nutr_regm.title: mineral nutrient regimen
mineral_nutr_regm.description: Information about treatment involving the use of mineral supplements; should include the name of mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple mineral nutrient regimens

non_min_nutr_regm.title: non mineral nutrient regimen
non_min_nutr_regm.description: Information about treatment involving the exposure of plant to non-mineral nutrient such as oxygen, hydrogen or carbon; should include the name of non-mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple non-mineral nutrient regimens

pesticide_regm.title: pesticide regimen
pesticide_regm.description: Information about treatment involving use of insecticides; should include the name of pesticide, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple pesticide regimens

ph_regm.title: pH regimen
ph_regm.description: Information about treatment involving exposure of plants to varying levels of ph of the growth media, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimen

radiation_regm.title: radiation regimen
radiation_regm.description: Information about treatment involving exposure of plant or a plant part to a particular radiation regimen; should include the radiation type, amount or intensity administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple radiation regimens

rainfall_regm.title: rainfall regimen
rainfall_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to a given amount of rainfall, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

salt_regm.title: salt regimen
salt_regm.description: Information about treatment involving use of salts as supplement to liquid and soil growth media; should include the name of salt, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple salt regimens

samp_dis_stage.title: sample disease stage
samp_dis_stage.description: Stage of the disease at the time of sample collection, e.g. inoculation, penetration, infection, growth and reproduction, dissemination of pathogen.

season_environment.title: season environment
season_environment.description: Treatment involving an exposure to a particular season (e.g. Winter, summer, rabi, rainy etc.), treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment

standing_water_regm.title: standing water regimen
standing_water_regm.description: Treatment involving an exposure to standing water during a plant's life span, types can be flood water or standing water, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

tiss_cult_growth_med.title: tissue culture growth medium
tiss_cult_growth_med.description: Description of plant tissue culture growth media used

water_temp_regm.title: water temperature regimen
water_temp_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to water with varying degree of temperature, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

extreme_event.title: extreme event
extreme_event.description: Unusual physical events that may have affected microbial populations

fire.title: fire
fire.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of fire

flooding.title: flooding
flooding.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of flooding

agrochem_addition.title: agrochemical addition
agrochem_addition.description: Addition of fertilizers, pesticides, etc. - amount and time of applications

crop_rotation.title: crop rotation
crop_rotation.description: Whether or not crop is rotated, and if yes, rotation schedule

drainage_class.title: drainage class
drainage_class.description: Drainage classification from a standard system such as the USDA system

link_class_info.title: link to classification information
link_class_info.description: Link to digitized soil maps or other soil classification information

previous_land_use_meth.title: previous land use method
previous_land_use_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining previous land use and dates

annual_precpt.title: average annual precipitation
annual_precpt.description: The average of all annual precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

season_precpt.title: average seasonal precipitation
season_precpt.description: The average of all seasonal precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

misc_param.title: miscellaneous parameter
misc_param.description: Any other measurement performed or parameter collected, that is not listed here

organism_count.title: organism count
organism_count.description: Total cell count of any organism (or group of organisms) per gram, volume or area of sample, should include name of organism followed by count. The method that was used for the enumeration (e.g. qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) Should also be provided. (example: total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qpcr)

perturbation.title: perturbation
perturbation.description: Type of perturbation, e.g. chemical administration, physical disturbance, etc., coupled with perturbation regimen including how many times the perturbation was repeated, how long each perturbation lasted, and the start and end time of the entire perturbation period; can include multiple perturbation types

density.title: density
density.description: Density of the sample, which is its mass per unit volume (aka volumetric mass density)

pressure.title: pressure
pressure.description: Pressure to which the sample is subject to, in atmospheres

redox_potential.title: redox potential
redox_potential.description: Redox potential, measured relative to a hydrogen cell, indicating oxidation or reduction potential

tot_depth_water_col.title: total depth of water column
tot_depth_water_col.description: Measurement of total depth of water column

turbidity.title: turbitidy
turbidity.description: Measure of the amount of cloudiness or haziness in water caused by individual particles

atmospheric_data.title: atmospheric data
atmospheric_data.description: Measurement of atmospheric data; can include multiple data

bac_prod.title: bacterial production
bac_prod.description: Bacterial production in the water column measured by isotope uptake

bac_resp.title: bacterial respiration
bac_resp.description: Measurement of bacterial respiration in the water column

down_par.title: downward PAR
down_par.description: Visible waveband radiance and irradiance measurements in the water column

fluor.title: fluorescence
fluor.description: Raw or converted fluorescence of water

primary_prod.title: primary production
primary_prod.description: Measurement of primary production, generally measured as isotope uptake

water_current.title: water current
water_current.description: Measurement of magnitude and direction of flow within a fluid

size_frac_low.title: size fraction lower threshold
size_frac_low.description: Refers to the mesh/pore size used to pre-filter/pre-sort the sample. Materials larger than the size threshold are excluded from the sample

size_frac_up.title: size fraction upper threshold
size_frac_up.description: Refers to the mesh/pore size used to retain the sample. Materials smaller than the size threshold are excluded from the sample

methane.title: methane
methane.description: Methane (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling

particle_class.title: particle class
particle_class.description: Particles are classified, based on their size, into six general categories:clay, silt, sand, gravel, cobbles, and boulders; should include amount of particle preceded by the name of the particle type; can include multiple values

porosity.title: porosity
porosity.description: Porosity of deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample

diss_carb_dioxide.title: dissolved carbon dioxide
diss_carb_dioxide.description: Concentration of dissolved carbon dioxide in the sample or liquid portion of the sample

diss_inorg_carb.title: dissolved inorganic carbon
diss_inorg_carb.description: Dissolved inorganic carbon concentration in the sample, typically measured after filtering the sample using a 0.45 micrometer filter

diss_org_carb.title: dissolved organic carbon
diss_org_carb.description: Concentration of dissolved organic carbon in the sample, liquid portion of the sample, or aqueous phase of the fluid

diss_org_nitro.title: dissolved organic nitrogen
diss_org_nitro.description: Dissolved organic nitrogen concentration measured as; total dissolved nitrogen - NH4 - NO3 - NO2

magnesium.title: magnesium
magnesium.description: Concentration of magnesium in the sample

mean_peak_frict_vel.title: mean peak frictional velocity
mean_peak_frict_vel.description: Measurement of mean peak friction velocity

n_alkanes.title: n-alkanes
n_alkanes.description: Concentration of n-alkanes; can include multiple n-alkanes

nitrite.title: nitrite
nitrite.description: Concentration of nitrite in the sample

phaeopigments.title: phaeopigments
phaeopigments.description: Concentration of phaeopigments; can include multiple phaeopigments

phosplipid_fatt_acid.title: phospholipid fatty acid
phosplipid_fatt_acid.description: Concentration of phospholipid fatty acids; can include multiple values

potassium.title: potassium
potassium.description: Concentration of potassium in the sample

diether_lipids.title: diether lipids
diether_lipids.description: Concentration of diether lipids; can include multiple types of diether lipids

sulfate.title: sulfate
sulfate.description: Concentration of sulfate in the sample

sulfide.title: sulfide
sulfide.description: Concentration of sulfide in the sample

salinity.title: salinity
salinity.description: Salinity is the total concentration of all dissolved salts in a water sample. While salinity can be measured by a complete chemical analysis, this method is difficult and time consuming. More often, it is instead derived from the conductivity measurement. This is known as practical salinity. These derivations compare the specific conductance of the sample to a salinity standard such as seawater

salinity_method.title: salinity method
salinity_method.description: Method used to determine sample salinity

alkalinity.title: alkalinity
alkalinity.description: Alkalinity, the ability of a solution to neutralize acids to the equivalence point of carbonate or bicarbonate

nitrate.title: nitrate
nitrate.description: Concentration of nitrate in the sample

diss_inorg_phosp.title: dissolved inorganic phosphate
diss_inorg_phosp.description: Concentration of dissolved inorganic phosphorus in the sample

tot_diss_nitro.title: total dissolved nitrogen
tot_diss_nitro.description: Total dissolved nitrogen concentration, reported as nitrogen, measured by: total dissolved nitrogen = NH4 + NO3NO2 + dissolved organic nitrogen

tot_nitro.title: total nitrogen
tot_nitro.description: Total nitrogen concentration of water samples, calculated by: total nitrogen = total dissolved nitrogen + particulate nitrogen. Can also be measured without filtering, reported as nitrogen

tot_phosp.title: total phosphate
tot_phosp.description: Total phosphorus concentration in the sample, calculated by: total phosphorus = total dissolved phosphorus + particulate phosphorus

microbial_biomass.title: microbial biomass
microbial_biomass.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units

microbial_biomass_meth.title: microbial biomass method
microbial_biomass_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass

microbial_biomass_C.title: microbial biomass carbon
microbial_biomass_C.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units

micro_biomass_C_meth.title: microbial biomass carbon method
micro_biomass_C_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass

microbial_biomass_N.title: microbial biomass nitrogrn
microbial_biomass_N.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units

micro_biomass_N_meth.title: microbial biomass nitrogen method
micro_biomass_N_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass nitrogen

org_nitro_method.title: organic nitrogen method
org_nitro_method.description: Method used for obtaining organic nitrogen

tot_nitro_content.title: total nitrogen content
tot_nitro_content.description: Total nitrogen content of the sample

tot_nitro_cont_meth.title: total nitrogen content method
tot_nitro_cont_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the total nitrogen

tot_org_c_meth.title: total organic carbon method
tot_org_c_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining total organic carbon

tot_org_carb.title: total organic carbon
tot_org_carb.description: Definition for soil: total organic carbon content of the soil, definition otherwise: total organic carbon content

al_sat_meth.title: aluminum saturation method
